text: Filed owner-authored, unlabeled #6677 evidence gap: Windows immutable-audit append verifies directory handles but subsequently creates and publishes by path string, unlike POSIX descriptor-relative operations. Linux cannot settle the Windows-only directory-replacement/reparse timing sequence; copperfin-access365-win11 could not be resolved for replay. #4375 covers earlier symlink/hard-link work but not this timing window.
